items.prompt: A call finishes in the money. What follows about its long holder's profit?

options.text: Profit must be positive regardless of premium
options.why: The premium can exceed terminal payoff.

options.text: Positive payoff can still mean negative profit
options.why: The worked 5000 payoff is below 7000 premium.

options.text: Profit is exactly zero whenever the terminal spot lies above strike but below breakeven
options.why: In that region intrinsic payoff is positive but smaller than premium under the stated zero-cost model.
Contract multipliers vary and must be specified.

items.explanation: In-the-money describes exercise value, not recovery of premium/financing/fees.
